Proposition
[The normalized family becomes ancient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0120, page-0121, page-0122, page-0123 ↗ lem:chow-iii-normalized-family-noncollapsed 1. ch19:19.31\group Spherical Construction

For the normalized family, $t_0(L)=-T_L/(T_L-t_L)$ tends to $-\infty $ as $L\to \infty $. The proof uses the scalar-curvature bounds, the changing-distance estimate, and the lower bound $\operatorname {diam}\hat g_L(t_0(L))\ge L/\sqrt{T_L-t_L}$.
